description: Free. Yesterday's odds for a pump.fun coin at each market cap: for every band ($5k-10k up to $250k-1M), how many coins first traded inside it, and what share went on to 2x, 5x, 10x and 20x within three hours, with the median peak. Dead coins count. For: what are the odds a pump.fun coin at $20k does a 2x, how often coins at a market cap run. A coin's own odds depend on its deployer and early buyers: check_coin. Any window: base_rate (paid).
name: odds_by_market_cap
